Sure thing - recently picked this thing called letterpress! So far it is sooo rewarding - like getting an artist stamp. It is all this old-school type stuff, printing things from a hand-fed, manually operated big ol press.

The best way i have to explain letterprinting - imagine the type in your computer printer but each individual alphabet character and other letters, symbols etc have its very individual shape carved as blocks, stacked into "type cases." 

And so then with a metal handle, I pull down to manually crank that massive platten, and all those individual characters that make a page are smashed under the weight, and voa - there on this special paper - is this crisp print!

It's been super cathartinc, you have to really think out the words and images to print - so much care is involved and then it is all revealed when the sheet of print emerges after being rung between two giant heavy stones! I can see my name carved as my letterpress logo now. 

And also just getting all of the little details
